scope: Theorem A.1 (Uniform concentration) of the manuscript “The higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture” (preprints/The-higher-dimensional-Erdos-distinct-distances-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 166 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 37f6355365a18510), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 75. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix C0 ≥ 1. Let A ≥ 1 and let P be a finite set of distinct parameters [v : y] ∈ Q, all with v ̸= 0. Assume: (i) For every λ ∈ P there is a homogeneous polynomial of positive degree at most C0A which is nonzero at λ and zero at every other member of P. (ii) Every projective Pr ⊂ Q contains at most C0Ar−1 members of P. There is a constant C = C(e, C0) such that #{λ ∈ P : Fλ ⊂ V } ≤ C deg(V )Ah , dim V = s0 + h, 1 ≤ h < r, (A.2) for irreducible proper affine varieties V ⊂ S, in either of these settings: (a) All such V are allowed, and |P| ≤ C0Ar. (b) Only V contained in the zero set of some nonzero polynomial of degree at most C0A are allowed. No bound on |P| is required.
